title: Explicit drug-pair labels in Drug Interaction Checker results

requirements.summary: Show an explicit "<Drug A> + <Drug B>" label for every pairwise Drug-Drug interaction result, including no-data cases.
acceptanceCriteria: After running "Check Interactions" with >= 2 drug names, each rendered pairwise result section/card includes a prominent drug-pair label in the format "<Drug A> + <Drug B>".
If the app shows a per-pair "no interaction data found" message, that message is displayed together with the drug-pair label for the same pair (not as a standalone message without the pair context).
The drug-pair label uses the same displayed drug names as the interaction object’s drugs fields (e.g., interaction.drugs.drugA and interaction.drugs.drugB), and is user-facing English text.

file_operations.description: Update the Drug-Drug tab pairwise interaction rendering to always include a prominent drug-pair label derived from interaction.drugs.drugA and interaction.drugs.drugB (formatted as "<Drug A> + <Drug B>") at the top of each pair result card/section, and ensure the label remains visible in both the details-present path and the per-pair no-data message path. Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

Add or update a small utility helper to format a user-facing drug pair label from two displayed drug names (e.g., (drugA, drugB) => `${drugA} + ${drugB}`) so the UI can use a single consistent formatter for the per-pair header label.
